assumptions: LDO 3.3V: ME6211C33M5G-N per core defaults (defaulted)

RP2040: native USB, no USB-UART bridge needed (defaulted)

12MHz crystal: X322512MSB4SI from parts library (defaulted)
RP2040 decoupling: 4x 100nF on 3V3, 2x 100nF + 10uF on 1V1, 100nF on ADC and USB per datasheet (defaulted)
Castellated GPIO pads: 30 pads, one per GPIO, using 1x01 pin header footprint as edge pad placeholder (defaulted)
QSPI pull-ups: 4x 10k on CS/SCK/D0-D3 per RP2040 hardware design guide (defaulted)
CC1/CC2 pull-downs: 5.1k each for USB-C device detection (defaulted)
BOOTSEL button: EVQP7A01P tactile switch from parts library (defaulted)
SWD header: 1x03 2.54mm pin header for SWCLK/SWDIO/GND debug access (defaulted)

substitutions.reason: SOIC-8 variant in stock at LCSC C2456211; same 16Mbit QSPI NOR flash

assumptions: The board is powered solely from USB VBUS (5V) with no external power input (defaulted).
The 3.3V rail is generated by a single LDO regulator from the 5V USB input (defaulted).
The RP2040 is used in its default boot configuration with QSPI flash as the primary boot source (defaulted).
The 12 MHz crystal is a standard parallel-resonant crystal with the RP2040's internal oscillator circuit (defaulted).
Castellated GPIO pads expose a subset of the RP2040's GPIO pins, with the exact pin selection deferred to the architecture stage (defaulted).
USB-C is used in a device-only configuration (no USB-PD or dual-role power) (defaulted).
The board does not include an external reset button or user LEDs unless required by the architecture stage (defaulted).
